test_title: PYST 17 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: 18 men can complete a work in 20 days. After 10 days, 6 men leave. In how many more days will the remaining men finish the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Men = 18

Total days = 20

Work done in 10 days

Remaining men = 12

**Formula Used:**

Total work = Men × Days

Remaining work = Total work − Work done

Days = Remaining work ÷ Remaining men

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = 18 × 20 = 360

⇒ Work done in 10 days = 18 × 10 = 180

⇒ Remaining work = 360 − 180 = 180

⇒ Days required = 180 ÷ 12 = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15.**
